title: Native Collective Research Effort to Enhance Wellness (N CREW) Program: Addressing Overdose, Substance Use, Mental Health, and Pain – Advancing Native Research Projects
issuing_orgs: National Institute of Neurological Disorders and Stroke
National Institute on Minority Health and Health Disparities
National Center for Advancing Translational Sciences
purpose_tldr: Announces Research Opportunity Announcement OTA-26-001, the companion to OTA-26-002 under Phase II of the NIH HEAL Initiative's N CREW Program. It solicits Tribes and Native Serving Organizations to conduct community-led research focused on overdose, substance use (including opioids and stimulants), or pain, with optional inclusion of mental health and wellness.
eligibility_tldr: Applicants are Tribes and Native Serving Organizations (T/NSOs) leading community-led research. Projects must explicitly center overdose, substance use, or pain and may incorporate related health and wellness outcomes for Native communities.
dos: Center the research question on overdose, substance use, or pain as required by the ROA
Plan to coordinate with Native Research Resource Partners funded under the companion OTA-26-002
Attend informational webinars listed on the N CREW Program website
Submit applications by the July 31, 2026 due date
Engage community partners early to support community-led design
donts: Do not propose research that omits overdose, substance use, or pain as the primary focus
Do not treat the NRRP network as a separate effort; integrate engagement plans with it
Do not delay outreach to community partners until after submission
strategic_priorities: Overdose, substance use, and pain reduction
